dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol 'jig rten dga' ba'i gtam 〉zhes sbya ba 'di nyid ni lha sa grong khyer khongs lhun grub rdzong slob 'bring gi bod yig dge rgan bsod nams chos dar lags kyis rang gi phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba'i nyams myong gi rmang gzhi'i steng 'brel yod yig cha khag la zur blta dang / myong ba rgas po'i gtam gyis zur brgyan te brtsams sgrung gi rnam pa'i thog nas chang sa'i mdzad sgo'i mgo slong chang btang ba nas mjug skyo log tu phebs pa'i bar gyi brgyud rim cha tshang zhib 'bri gnang 'dug pas 'dis gcig nas rgya che'i klog pa po dang zhib 'jug pa tshor lha sa khul gyi chang sa'i mdzad sgo'i skabs kyi mi sna mi 'dra ba khag dang / de dag so po'i las 'gan/ bya ba'i rgyud rim/ mi sna phan tshun gyi gshags dang /gzhas chen/ chang gzhas sogs la zhib 'jug dang rgyud mnga' yong ba bya rgyur phan pa chen po yong nges dang /gnyis nas da phan chang sa'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i skor gyi zhib 'bri byas pa'i dpe deb cig dpe skrun bya myong med pa de'i stong cha kha skong yong nges la dmigs 'di ga nged dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun zhus pa lags na 'dis kyang bod rig pa 'di nyid ma nyams gong 'phel dang nyams pa sor chud kyi grogs su sman par gyur cig gumi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/
dkar chagdang po/ sngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)gnyis pa/ slong chang phul nas g.yu chung btags pa/ (3)gsum pa/ chang sa'i sngon 'gro'i gra sgrig (12)bzhi pa/ mna' ma'i khyim du chang sa'i mdzad sgo bshams pa/ (14)lnga pa/ mna' ma bsus nas bu'i khyim du chang sa'i mdzad sgo bshams pa/ (72)drug pa/ sbyin bdag gis rta pa dang khrung ma sogs la thugs rje legs 'bul zhu ba/ (137)bdun pa/ bu dang mna' ma skyo log tu phebs pa (143)
dang po/ sngon 'gro'i gtam/snying po med pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zhes1'jig rten 'khor bar smad par byed srid kyang 1'khor ba'i las la snying po mi 'dug na//khyod kyi lus rten de yang ji ltar grubakapha shul bu 'dzin ma shul bu mos 'dzin1'jig rten 'khor lo rtag tu 'khor tshul gyi1pho mo'i gnyen sgrig 'khor ba'i don bzang po//gangs can na gzhon dgyes pa'i gtam du gleng 1zhes tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis mdun legs par bsus te gang gleng bar bya ba ni dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i ston pa'i bka' lung lta bu zhig min na yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su gnas bca' ba'i srog ldan kun gyis dga' bde'i dpal la spyod pa'i pho mo zung sbyor gyi sngon 'gro'i bya ba gnyen sgrig dga' ston bya tshul te bla ma re la chos lugs re/ lung pa re la cha lugs re zer ba ji bzhin 'dir rang cag lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol skor rgyas pa zhig 'bri ba la sngon lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol mtshon pa'i rtsom yig re 'ga' klog pa po'i spyan lam du mngon myong yang de dag ni phyogs bsdus tsam mam mtshon byed tsam las de tsam gyi zhib phra zhig byung med par brten rang nyid kyi grogs dga' nye dang ngo shes pa mang pos cis kyang lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol skor gyi rtsom deb cha tshang zhing khungs btsan pa zhig 'bri rogs 1
zhes re skul thengs mang gnang ba'i bka' ma bcag tsam du lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig gi lam srol rgyas pa zhig ste 'go slong chang ster tshul nas mjug skyo log bar gyi brgyud rim cha tshang zhig 'bri khul lags kyang rtsom mkhan la don dngos kyi shes bya dman zhing lag len gyi 'jon thang zhan pas nor 'dzol 'byung rigs kyang 'di ni dbyar thog ma'i 'brug sgra tsam lags na slad 'di las kyang gra rgyas shing phun sum tshogs pa zhig gsar rtsom gnang rgyur re smon zhu bzhin mchis/
gnyis pa/ slong chang phul nas g.yu chung brtags pa/de yang dbus phyogs lha sa'i byang ngos su chags pa'i 'phan yul 'jon byang lho ba'i a khu nyi ma lha dkar gyi bu lha rgod g.yu rgyal dang dbus phyogs lha sa'i shar ngos su chags pa'i 'brom stod tshong 'dus nang 'og gi bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris gnyis sngon bsags las smon bzang po'i lcags kyu yis rgyal stod lha khang 'cham la ma bos ngang gis bkug ste thog mar brtse dga'i mig mda' 'phen res byas te brtse dung gi sa bon dang po btab pa nas bzung rim bzhin brtse dung gi myu gu ches cher bud de deng skabs gcig sems gcig la chags nas skad cig tsam yang bral mi phod pa'i dus la slebs pa na/ 'jon byang lho ba'i yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis yum chen a ma lags la gros 'go'i tshul du yā gna' mi'i bod kyi gtam dpe la pha ma shi bu mi 'tshar zhes pa'i dpe ltar a ma rang las bzod bde ru dang nga'i phrag pa'i steng gi 'gan 'khri de cung zhig yang du 'gro rgyu'i slad du bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris de nyid nga tsho'i khyim du bag mar bsus na zhes brjod par yum chen padma dkar mo de yis pha shul bu 'dzin bya rgyu de 'jig rten mi chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig lags na lo rgan drug cur nye ba'i rgan rgon gnyis nas 'jig rten phyi mar phan pa'i dge ba'i bya gzhag sna re gnyis tsam bsgrub nas 'jig rten 'di gang gi bya gzhag rnams bu dang mna' ma gnyis la ris sprod kyis sngar las lhag pa'i pha shul bu 'dzin zhig byung na cis mi dga'/ 'on kyang dam pa'i legs bshad las/ rang gis legs par shes na yang / bya ba thams 3
cad gros kyis sgrubs/ mi gang gros la mi dga' ba/ 'gyod pa rin gyis nyos pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon la rang dgar thag ma bcad par ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyi mo lung gsung brtag cig zhus te bu dang bu mo las 'gro yod med de cis kyang brtag dgos gsungs bas yab chen nyi ma lha dkar gyis yum chen lags kyis gsungs ba de bden par byung zhes gsungs nas sang nyin snga por mal las langs te ngo lag gtsang mar bkrus nas mjal dar dkar gtsang gcig dang shog sgor lnga bcas gra sgrig gis thang zag chos 'khor dgon gyi bla rgan chos kyi mthar ba'i sku mdun du ngo bcar gyis mjal dar dkar gtsang sngon du btang nas bu dang mna' ma'i lo rgyus rnams zhib par brjod de khong gnyis tshe gang gtan gyi grogs su las 'gro yod min la brtag par zhu zhes brjod par bla rgan nas lags so zhes gsung bzhin mo sho cha de phyag gnyis kyi bar du bcug ste 'phur 'phur cung zad btang ba dang chabs cig phu zhig brgyab nas dpral pa ru gtugs te ngag nas skyabs 'gro dang ma ṇi bgrang bzhin yud tsam bzhugs rjes mo sho de gnyis mo gdan gyi steng du dbyug byung ba dang der zhib par gzigs rjes/ spyir btang mo 'bras legs po 'dug kyang kha dzar cung zad cig 'dug pa la skyon med de/ kha dzar byung ba rgyal ba'i bka' yis gsos gsungs bas gzungs 'dus thengs gcig klog na de gas 'thus gsungs so/ de nas yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de nyid khyim du ma log gong dgon pa'i mkhan rin po che'i sku mdun du ngo bcar gyis khyim du gzungs 'dus ljags klog zhu mkhan dge 'dun bzhi grwa gcig gtong gnang skyabs 'jug zhus par mkhan rin po che nas de ring bod zla bcu pa'i tshes drug la rtsis pas tshes bcu'i nyin gzungs 'dus klog rgyu'i tshe cha gtan 'khel byas so/ yab chen nyi ma lha dkar dgon pa nas kha bral te khyim du phebs pa dang /khyim nang slebs rjes yum chen a mas gtsos pa'i nang mi rnams la mo 'bras 4
rnams brjod bzhin nang mi tshang ma rgyal ba'i bka' yi snying po gzungs 'dus klog pa'i sta gon la zhugs so//rgyal ba'i bka' yi snying po gzungs 'dus ljags klog zhu ba'i byed sgo rnams legs par bsgrubs pa dang bod sa stag lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin re gza' phur bu dang skar ma rgyal 'khel bas phur bu rgyal gyi grub sbyor zhes tshe cha shin tu legs pas de'i nyin slong chang ster rgyu'i tshe cha ru gtan 'khel ba na yab chen nyi ma lha dkar gyis zhogs pa snga po nas mal las langs te ngo lag gtsang mar bkrus nas gzab mchor legs par spras thog rta po gser sgong rag pa la rta sga zi ling sbal kha dang kha shog bya 'brug kha sprod cig brgyab ste mchod chang sbrang rtsi lta bu g.yas su btags nas 'brom stod tshong 'dus nang 'og la chas so//tshong 'dus nang 'og de ni gzims shag che yang mi che ka ba bcu drug dang gzims shag chung yang mi chung ka ba bcu drug las bsgrubs shing khyim tshang 'di'i yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral dang yum chen gangs lha padma gnyis ni thugs yangs pa nam mkha' lta bu dang sems mthun pa chu dang chu bya lta bu zhig yod la rnam kun nas kun dang mthun pa bde skyid kyi rtsa ba ru 'dzin mkhan zhig yin pa na de ring 'jon byang lho ba'i yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de nyid khyim du 'byor bar dga' ba'i 'dzum dang snyan pa'i tshig gis legs par bsus te gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil du gdan drangs so//gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil gyi nang du yab chen gnyis po dkyil krung gru bzhi sho 'dra zhig byas te gral du 'khod pa na yum chen gangs lha padma de yis khog ltar gser gyi mdog can nang nas ba mar dkar po'i gsol ja kha dog cung zad dkar lhang lhang zhig dkar yol dkar sangs nang zhus shing zhal nas yā bod gangs can dkar po gangs ris bskor/ nga a mas 5
dkar gtsang zhal dkar nang / dkar 'o ma'i nying khu gsol ja drangs/'di dkar gsum 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel ni/ skyid rtsa ba tshugs pa'i snga ltas yin/ zhes bzhad gad dang sprags gsungs byung ba na/ yab chen gnyis ni yum chen gangs lha padmo'i gsung gleng 'jol mo'i drug 'gyur de dag rna ba'i bcud kyi bu ram du 'gyur te yud tsam ring zhal yang btsum mi thub par lus so//de nas gang 'tshams song ba na yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis mchod chang sbrang rtsi'i nying khu 'dra ba zhig dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro'i nang blugs nas yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral gyi phyag tu phul/ yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral nas dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro phyag tu bsnams te mchod dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal la mchod/ lha dang bla ma'i zhal la mchod/ yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal la mchod ces phud stor lan gsum gnang ste mchod chang gsum sgron mnyes dag cig zhus nas dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro de cog tse nar mo'i steng du bzhag pa na yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis slar yang dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro'i nang mchod chang gang zhus te yum chen a ma lags kyi phyag tu phul zhing yum chen a ma lags nas dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro phyag tu bsnams te phud stor lan gsum gnang nas cog tse nar mo'i steng du bzhag de nas yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis lnga 'brug sgra grags na char dang chang drangs na gtam zhes pa'i dpe ltar khyed rnam gnyis kyi bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris dang nged kyi bu lha rgod g.yu rgyal gnyis tshe gang gtan gyi grogs su las kyi sa bon btab zin la mo lung gsung brtag sogs gang nas dpyad kyang mthun par 'dugde na bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris de nyid nga yi khyim gyi bag ma ru ster gnang yod par mkhyen zhes snying kha rdo rje'i dbus nas re ba'i don bzang zhig skyabs 6
'jug zhu lags na mi bzang gi don bzang sgrub pa ji bzhin re ba'i 'bras bu smin par mdzod cig ces gsungs ba la yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral de yis mno bsam gyi dkyil 'khor dbyings su cung zad tsam zhugs te na re/shar phyogs ri bo ga tshod mtho na yang / nyi ma zla ba khog pa'i dpe don med/bu dang bu mo blo sems mthun 'gyur na/ pha mas bkag kyang gyod kyi gzhi ma yin/ nga yi snying nor dbyangs can mdzes ris 'di/ bu yis gtso byas yab yum lhan rgyas kyis/ byams dang brtse ba'i ngang nas bskyangs byas te/me tog btab sar 'bras bu smin gyur na/ khyod kyi 'dod don nga yis bsgrub par rigs/ 'on kyang yum chen gangs lha padma yis/ dgongs 'char ji yod srong por gsung bar zhu/ zhes gsungs bar yum chen gangs lha padma yis/ yab kyi bka' la ldog pa med na yang / chung nas brtse bas bskyangs pa'i bu mo 'di/ rtsa ba tshugs sar lo 'dab rgyas pa dang / 'tsho gos gang sar sdug tu ma 'jug pa'i/ zhal gsungs phyag len thub pa'i dam bca' zhig pha ma lhan 'dzoms khrod 'dir 'jog par mdzod/ ces gsungs bas yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de nyid dga' spro rab tu 'phel bzhin du/ ma bzang pos bskyangs pa'i bu mo 'di/ nged tshang gi bag mar bsus pa'i rjes/nged pha ma gnyis kyi bu phrug ltar/ dus kun tu brtse bas skyong rgyu yi/ pho rab kyi dam bca' nga yis 'jog dman bu mo yin yang pha ma dang / rogs bza' zla sogs la brtsi bkur gyis/ dman mdzangs ma'i yon tan skyong rgyu la/ khyed yab yum gnyis nas bslab bya mdzod/ ces gsungs so// de nas yab yum lhan rgyos gsol ja dang mchod chang mchod cing gang 'tshams nas nyin gung zhal lag phul ba dang zhal lag legs par bsgrubs rjes yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de nyid spro ba rab tu 'phel bzhin du rang yul 'jon byang du log go khong khyim du slebs pa dang yum chen a ma lags la tshong 'dus 7
nang 'og gi yab yum gnyis nas bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris de nyid khong tsho'i khyim gyi bag ma la gtong rgyu'i khas len gtsang ma byas pa'i bkra shis gtam bzang de brjod pa na yum chen a ma lags ni thugs rab tu mnyes pa'i ngang yāda 'o na nged rgan rgon gnyis kyi bsam don yid bzhin bsgrubs pa la bkra shis rten 'brel mtshon ched yab chen lags nas mchod chang gsum sgron mnyes dag cig gnang bar zhu zhes gsungs nas yab chen lags la mchod chang gsum sgron mnyes dag cig phul lo//de nas nyin shas song ba dang yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis slar yang thang zag chos 'khor dgon du bla rgan chos kyi mthar pa'i sku mdun du ngo bcar gyis dkar gtsang mjal dar sngon du btang nas 'brom stod tshong 'dus nang 'og gi bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris de nyid sngar mo yi lung bstan du babs pa ji bzhin nga yo khyim gyi bag ma la ster rgyu'i gtan 'khel zin par brten mchog nyid nas bu mo'i dbu la g.yu chung 'dogs pa'i tshe cha zhig gtan 'khel gnang bar zhu zhes brjod pas bla rgan mchog nas lo tho la zhib par gzigs te mtha'adon du bod sa stag lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu bzang bas de nyin g.yu chung 'dogs pa'i tshe cha ru gtan 'khel byas pa na yab chen nyi ma lha dkar gyis de don gtan 'khel zin pa'i tshe cha de 'brom stod tshong 'dus nang 'og la brda lan gsal bar phul lo//de ring ni bod sa stag lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun re gza' zla ba skar ma lha mtshams 'byung 'phrod sa chu bcas gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu bzang bas yab chen nyi ma lha dkar de yis rang lus la gzab mchor legs par spras/ rta po gser sgong rag pa la sga srab kyis legs par brgyan te rta sgro dkar po gru bzhi sho 'dra'i mtha' ru ko ba nag pos khyi sna 'khrid/ dkyil du nor bu me 'bar brgyab pa zhig byu bur bkang ste rta sga'i g.yas g.yon gnyis 8

kyang bzhugs gral du 'khod de re zhig yab chen rnam gnyis gsol ja mchod cing sngar song bya ba'i gleng mol la zhugs so/ de nas dus gang 'tshams song ba na a ma gangs lha padma yis spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas bkra shis rten 'brel gyi dang po gro ma 'bras sil bkyag cing zhal dkar dang po mchog gsum gyi mdun du phul ba dang de rjes yab chen rnam gnyis nas gtsos pa'i rim par zhal dkar re sgrig cing bu mo dbyangs can mdzes ris dang nang mi gzhan rnams kyang rgan gzhon gyi go rim bzhin gral la 'khod do/ nang mi tshang ma gral du 'khod zin pa dang yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral gyis 'bras sil gyis byur bur bkang pa'i zhal dkar de phyag tu bsnams te mchod sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ zhes brjod pa na yab chen nyi ma lha dkar sogs gral pa byings nas kyang mnyam du mchod pa phul rjes tshang mas 'bras sil gyi ro bcud la bro ba myong bzhin gda' 'o/ bkra shis rten 'brel gyi dang po gro ma 'bras sil legs par phul bsgrubs pa dang yab chen nyi ma lha dkar gyis gral gyi dbus nas yar bzhengs te rta sgro gru bzhi'i nang nas zhal tog gis bkang pa'i slo ma de yar la bton te yab chen lags nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral pa byings la lan re phul te rgya lcog gru bzhi'i steng du bzhag de nas mjal dar nyi ma bde legs dkar po gangs ri 'dra ba re gral mgo yab chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral gsham bar tshang ma'i mgul du re re sgron/ de rjes mchod chang bdud tsi lta bu zhig yab chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro'i nang zhus te phul bas yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral gyis dngul phor g.yang bzhag bag gro phyag tu bsnams te mchod rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che/padma 'byung gnas sku la 'das grongs med/ da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon 10

mdog tshang nas yod/ 'byung ba lnga yi khyad chos tshang nas yod/ dar 'di a sne la dar dkar yod/ dar dkar po nyi ma bde legs yod/ dar dkar po nyi ma bde legs 'di/ lug g.yang dkar brgya yi mkhal bal yin/lug g.yang dkar ma mo'i khyu tshogs kyi/ dus bzhi yi rtsi bcud rab ngoms pas/ bal bzang po bregs pa'i dus la babs/ bal breg dus lha chen brgya yis bregs/ bal 'khel dus lha mo brgya yis 'khel/ bal 'thag dus klu mo brgya yis btags/ gnyan lha klu 'dzoms pa'i dar dkar yin/ dar 'di la lha dgu 'khrungs nas yod/ sku dang po thub pa sangs rgyas 'khrungs/sku gnyis pa snying rje'i lha mchog 'khrungs/ sku gsum pa tshangs pa dkar po 'khrungs/ sku bzhi pa ngag gi dbang phyug 'khrungs/ sku lnga pa sgrol ma dkar mo 'khrungs/ sku drug pa rig pa'i lha mo 'khrungs/ sku bdun pa phyag na rdo rje 'khrungs/ sku brgyad pa rta mgrin dmar po 'khrungs/ sku dgu pa gling rje ge sar 'khrungs/ 'di lha dgu 'dzoms pa'i lha dar yin/ nga'i lha dar nyi ma bde legs 'di/ bod gangs can ljongs su 'khyer zer na/ lha bla ma mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/ smad rgya nag yul du 'khyer zer na/ gong dpon po mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/ dus de ring bkra shis dga' ston la/dar 'di ko yar la 'phyar zer na/ sgo 'di la mi byes rang dbang med/ ki ki so so lha rgyal lo/ zhes ldeng sgra dang bcas te sgo mo phun tshogs gzhung sgo de yar la 'dzul ba dang zhang g.yog bsod nams rdo rje yis sgo'i g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i so nam gyi yo chas la sogs pa'i dngos rigs yod do cog la mjal dar sgron pa dang zhang chen nas sgo mo'i g.yas su bshams pa'i lci phud de la bstod pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//mtho gangs can byang thang yangs po la/ rtswa tsi thog ro bcud phun sum tshogs/ de longs su spyod pa'i 'bri g.yag nor/ nor stong tsho gcig gi lci 31
phud de/ dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug bar sa gzhi phun tshogs dbus gtsang yul/ rigs rgyu ba bzang ba'i mdzo mo mang / bar mdzo mo stong gi lce phud de/ dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug smad mdo khams yul de rgya che bas/ ba be'u'i phyugs rgyud lhag par bzang / ba stong tsho gcig gi khu phud de/ dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug phud dang po smyu ba'i phung po 'dir/ bkra shis pa'i mjal dar sgron rgyu yin/zhes brjod bzhin mjal dar nyi ma bde legs de spru phud la sgron nas sgo mo'i g.yon phyogs la phebs te slar yang mjal dar nyi ma bde legs shig yar la 'phyar nas chu phud de la phud stor lan gsum mdzad de bstod pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//o so sti bde legs su gyur cig gangs rin chen ti se'i 'dab rol nas/ chu rin chen yan lag brgyad ldan byung / chu mngar ba ka ra bu ram dang / chu bsil ba char rjes rlung po 'dra/ chu 'jam pa g.yang mo'i bal la 'gran/ chu yang pa bya yi sgro 'dra ba/ chu dwangs ba ston gyi nam mkha' bzhin/chu gtsang ba tshangs pa'i gter chu la/ chu mgrin par ma gnod lto ba bde/chu 'di la chu dar 'di sgron pas/ lha mchog gsum mnyes pa'i rten 'brel yod/ces gsung bzhin mjal dar bkra shis rtags brgyad de chu ban la sgron rjes zhang chen dang zhang g.yog gnyis nas gom stabs dal po'i ngang gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil gyi phyogs su phebs pa dang chabs cig gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//smin sgrol gling gi rtsa ba/ rtsa ba g.yu yi rdo gcal/ de la 'gran zla mi 'dug gro dkar gro dmar shig shig smin sgrol gling gi sked pa/ sked pa sgo mang rab gsal/ de la 'gran zla mi 'dug gser gyi pa ṭa shig shig32
smin sgrol gling gi rtse mo/ rtse mo gdugs dang dar lcog de la 'gran zla mi 'dug gser gyi rgya phibs shig shigces snyan po'i dbyangs rta ring mo la drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/smin sgrol gling gi rgyab ri/ rgyab ri brag la bcol yod/ brag la 'gyur ba ma gtong / thang dkar gnas bzod bde ba/ smin sgrol gling gi mdun ri/ mdun ri mtsho la bcol yod/ mtsho la 'gyur ba ma gtong /ser bya gnas bzod bde ba/zhes a ma khrung ma rnams kyi ram 'degs 'og zhabs bro bskyon byung ba dang de nas zhang chen skal bzang bag gro de yis rgya lcog gru bzhi'i steng du bzhag pa'i 'bo de yi 'khris su bcar nas rang nyid kyi phyag nang yod pa'i mda' dar de 'bo yi steng du btsugs nas am phrag las dkar gtsang kha btags shig bton te rgya lcog gru bzhi'i steng gi 'bo de la bshad pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//o so ste bde legs su gyur cig nor bu dga' 'khyil 'khrungs pa'i rgya lcog steng / 'bo la bzang po gser gyi kha rgyan bzhugs/ 'bo 'di bskrun pa'i bskrun rab brjod dgos na/ bzo bo mkhas pa bi sha kurmas bskrun/'bo 'di la phyi nang zur gug bzhi/ phyi zur bzhis rgyan pa'i dgos pa ni/phyi'i 'byung bzhi dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ nang gug bzhis rgyan pa'i dgos pa ni/ nor longs spyod g.yang du 'gug pa'i rtags/ de'i nang du yod pa'i gro bzang 'di/ lha 'dzam lha'i mdzod las drangs pa yin/ de'i steng du bzhag pa'i byang tshwa 'di/ las bya ba tshags su tshud pa'i rtags/de'i steng du btsugs pa'i mda' dar 'di/ lho rong smyug ma'i mda' dang gcig rin chen lcags kyi mde'u dang gnyis/ thang dkar rgod po'i sgro dang gsum/ gsal byed dngul dkar me long dang / sked 'ching dar tshon 33
sna lngas brgyan/ mda' 'di la tshangs pa'i lnga ldan zer/ ki ki so so bkra shis so//zhes brjod de dkar gtsang kha btags de 'bo la phul nas a ma khrung ma rnams kyi phebs bsu'i 'og gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil gyi nang du phyag la phebs pa dang / khrung ma sgrol ma nas gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad ces pa'i gzhas chen de dbu bkyag byung ba na zhang chen dang zhang g.yog dang khrung g.yog sogs tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis gzhas chen 'di phul lo//gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ bdag gi bla ma bzhugs yod/thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs yod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhugs nyams las dod pa/ gzhon pa nga tsho'i brten sa ma nor ba byas byung / gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ bdag gi dpon po bzhugs yod/ khams gsum dbang 'dus bzhugs yod/ khams gsum dbang 'dus bzhugs nyams las dod pa/ gzhon pa nga tsho'i brten sa ma nor ba byas byung / gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ bdag gi a ma bzhugs yod/ chang gzhi bag gro bzhugs yod/ a ma chang ma'i bzhugs nyams las dod pa/ gzhon pa nga tsho'i brten sa ma nor ba byas byung /zhes snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrog pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs su drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/ka ba 'gyur yong bsam nas/ ka gdan rdo la bcol yod/ gdung ma 'gyur yong bsam nas/ gzhu mo 'be log btang yod/ lcam dang dral ma rnams tsho/ rma bya'i sgro las mtshar ba/zhes zhabs bro gsum rgyag lad mo ngo mtshar dang ldan pa zhig brgyab byung ba dang de nas zhang chen skal bzang bag gro yis am phrag las dkar gtsang kha 34
btags shig yar la bton te mgrin pa gzengs tsam byas nas gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil nang bshams pa'i rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams la bkra shis ngag gi mchod pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//tsha so ste bde legs su gyur cig dgung a sngon mthon por skar ma bzang / dma' sa gzhi yangs por nyi ma dro/ bar gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor lhag par 'dzoms/ de 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel la/skyabs dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ skyabs dang po sangs rgyas dkon mchog mchod/ tshe 'di phyi skyobs pa'i bla ma yin/ skyabs gnyis pa dam chos dkon mchog mchod/ dge blang dor ston pa'i rtsa ba yin/ skyabs gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog mchod/ blo dge bar 'jug pa'i grogs bzang yin/ nga'i lag tu 'khyer ba'i mjal dar 'di/ mchog rnam gsum dgyes pa'i lha dar yin/zhes gsungs nas mjal dar dkar gtsang de nyid mchog gsum gyi sku la sgron no/ de nas slar yang mjal dar dkar gtsang zhig yar la bton nas gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil la bstod pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//tsha so ste bde legs su gyur cig gzim chung snang gsal dga' 'khyil/bzhengs pa'i lha khang 'dra byung / ka ba nor bus brgyan yod/ rin chen dang pos brgyan yod/ gdung ma nor bus brgyan yod/ rin chen g.yu yis brgyan yod/ ka mgor phra rgyan btab yod/ byu ru dmar po'i phra rgyan/nor bus ka gdung brgyan pas/ gzim chung 'od kyis khengs song / ldebs ris bkra shis rtags brgyad/ thog ras padma 'dab brgyad/ bzhugs gdan stag gdan gzig gdan/ cog tse stag shing dmar po/ 'di 'dra'i gzim chung mtshar po/ lha mi kun la mi 'dug bzhugs gral g.yas pa de ni/ zhang chen lags kyi bzhugs gnas/ bzhugs gral g.yon ma de ni/35
yab chen lags kyi bzhugs gnas/ bzhugs gral dkyil phyogs de ru/ bu dang bu mo'i bzhugs gnas/zhes brjod nas mjal dar dkar gtsang de nyid ka mgo la sgron nas zhang chen dang zhang g.yog bcas pa rim pas gral la 'khod do//zhang chen rnam pa bzhugs gral du 'khod zin pa dang gnyer chen dbang 'dus rgya mtsho yis dbu la zhwa mo rgya ze dang / zhabs la zhabs phyags yu ring /lus la gzab mchor gang zab/ mgul du dkar gtsang kha btags sogs gyon nas phrag pa g.yon ma'i steng du zhal cor dkar gtsang zhig bzhag ste zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa'i ngang zhang chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral pa byings la zhal dkar bkra shis rtags brgyad re btsugs pa dang gnyer g.yog bkra shis bsam 'grub kyis kyang lus la gzab mchor legs par brgyan te zhal ltar sngon po g.yu yi mdog can zhig las zhang chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral pa byings la gsol ja phul rjes gus zhabs kyi rnam pa dang bcas gzim chung phyi logs su phebs pa dang de rjes a ma khrung ma rnams kyis zhang chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis bzhes chas phyag tu phul ba na/ zhang chen skal bzang bag gro nas zhal dkar phyag tu bsnams te zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas mchod gangs can shing rta'i srol 'byed tsong kha pa/ dngos stobs rig pa'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab rje/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub rje/ rgyal ba yab sras gsum la mchod pa 'bul/zhes brjod pa na gral pa byings nas kyang zhang chen dang mnyam du ja yi mchod pa kur tshil lir 'bul bar byed do/ de nas gnyer chen dbang 'dus rgya mtsho yis zhal dkar dkar sangs sheg nang gro ma 'bras sil gangs ri spungs pa lta bu zhig bsnams te gzim chung nang phebs nas byin can mchog gsum gyi sku mdun du phul ba dang gnyer g.yog bkra shis bsam 'grub kyis 36
shing dkrol pa ṭa'i rgyan ris nang gro ma 'bras sil bsnams shing gnyer chen gyi sar phebs byung bas gnyer chen nas 'bras sil de dag zhang chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral pa byings kyi sku mdun du re re phul lo//zhang chen sogs gral pa byings kyis gro ma 'bras sil phyag gis bkyag ste slar yang skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / gang la gang 'dul bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pas/ drin chen bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/zhes mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis mchod pa phul rjes tshang mas rten 'brel mtshon ched kyi 'bras sil cung zad re mchod bzhin yud tsam bzhugs rjes rim pas zhal dkar rnams cog tse nar mo'i steng du bzhag byung ba na gnyer pa dang gnyer g.yog rnams kyis zhal dkar mar la bshams pa dang a ma khrung ma rnams kyis khrung phor dang ja khra bsnams te rten 'brel dang po 'bras sil gyi rgyab snon tshul du gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo1gral stod gser la bcol yod/ gser sku phyag na rdo rje/ gral dkyil g.yu la bcol yod/ g.yu yag sgrol ma gsung byon/ gral gsham dung la bcol yod/ dung gshog ra ma rgyal mo/zhes snyan 'jibs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dbyangs rta la drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/gral stod zhal dkar bzhad bzhad/ zhal dkar yu ring bzhad bzhad/gral dkyil mchod rdzas bzhad bzhad/ mchod rdzas rdzab ya ser po/ gral gsham ja khra bzhad bzhad/ ja khra gser gyi sgor mo/zhes brgyab pa dang khrung ma sgrol ma nas zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa'i ngang yā khrung por bkyag pa dang po de la zhang chen dang zhang g.yog rnam pas thugs 'dzems ye nas med par stod kyi gangs ri dkar po lan gcig 37
mjal bar zhu zhes brjod nas nga tsho 'di la 'dzoms 'dzoms/ gtan du 'dzoms rgyu byung na/ gtan du 'dzoms pa'i mi la/ snyung gzhi god chags ma gtong / zhes pa sogs snyan 'jibs ldan pa'i chang gzhas kyis sne drangs te zhang chen gnyis nas gtsos pa'i gral pa byings la khrung phor gangs ri mjal mjal re phul lo//gral pa byings la chang gzhas kyis sne drangs te mchod chang gangs ri mjal mjal re phul bsgrubs pa dang zhang chen skal bzang bag gro nas kyang gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//shar phyogs rgya ma'i rong gi/ rgya rag dang pos gcig zhus/ dbus phyogs 'bras mo'i gzhung gi/ 'bras chang sil mas gnyis zhus/ na ning gzhes ning btsos pa'i/ lo chang kham pas gsum zhus/ kha seng ston kha btsos pa'i/ ston chang sngon mos bzhi zhus/zhes snyan po'i dbyangs rta ring mo la drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/shar phyogs rgya ma'i rong gi/ rgya rag dang po de tsho/ grwa bzhi dpal ldan lha mo'i/ zhal lu brje yas dgos yod/ dbus phyogs 'bras mo'i gzhung gi/ 'bras chang sil ma de tsho/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i/zhal lu brje yas dgos yod/ na ning gzhes ning btsos pa'i lo chang kham pa de tsho/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i/ khrung phor brje yas dgos yod/ kha seng ston kha btsos pa'i/ ston chang sngon mo de tsho/ mi pho ge sar rgyal po'i/ khrung phor brje yas dgos yod/ces phyag g.yon ma'i dkyil mdzub tu gyon pa'i gser gyi tshigs khebs rta sga ma'i yu ba de cog tsi nar mo'i zur du tag sgra dang bcas bskyon byung ba na khrung ma sgrol ma yis yid sems rab tu mgu ba'i rnam pa dang bcas zhang chen lags kyis gsung gzhas gser gyi rgya gling btang ba lta bu zhig btang byung ngo 38

phra mo ngoms su chog pa yod/ zhabs bro bzang po g.yon la shig pa gnang dang / g.yon gzhu ltong phra mo ngoms su chog pa yod/ zhabs bro bzang po dkyil la shig pa gnang dang / dkyil bsod nams kha btags btang song chog pa yod do//zhes brgyab nas stag shar gzhon pa gnyis la mchod chang 'gyogs skabs khong gnyis nas mchod chang gangs ri mjal mjal zhig zhu mi dgos pa'i u tshugs nan po zhus na'ang 'ang chen lags gnyis nas kyang u tshugs mtha' la bskyal bas mthar mchod chang gangs ri mjal mjal re ma zhu thabs med byung ngo /de ltar stag shar gzhon pa gnyis po stod kyi gangs ri dkar po'i zhal mjal zhus zin pa dang gnyer chen padma dar rgyas gzim chung nang phebs te zhang chen rnam pa dang khrung ma rnams la zhu rgyur da ni bzhes thug mchod de gzims 'jags ma gnang na rna tshan mo'i chu tshod gnyis pa yol 'dug go zhes zhus pas 'ang chen gnyis nas da ni gnyer chen lags kyis gsungs ba ji bzhin tshang ma bzhes thug mchod de gzims 'jags gnang na dga' zhes brjod pa na gnyer g.yog kun dga' dbang phyug nas ma byan rnams kyi phyag rogs 'og bzhes thus rlangs pa 'thul 'thul zhig gral pa byings kyi sku mdun du drangs so/ gral pa byings rnams bzhes thug gi bro ba longs su spyad zin pa dang gnyer pa dang gnyer g.yog sa nyis kyis zhal dkar bsdus shing a ma khrung ma rnams nas slar yang bzhes thug gi rgyab snon tshul du gzhas chen 'di 'dra 'ig phul lo//gangs dkar gling gi dkyil la phyugs shig 'dzoms/ seng ge g.yu ral rgyas pa bdag la 'dzoms/ rgya zhing nar mo'i sgang la lo tog 'dzoms/ a pa rgya'u zhes pa bdag la 'dzoms/ dwangs sangs dbang mo'i dkyil la nya 113
zhig 'dzoms/ gser nya spa phrug bzhes pa bdag la 'dzoms/zhes snyan po'i ngag gi dril chung dkrol ba dang chabs cig zhabs bro/seng ge g.yu ral ngom dus/ gangs ri gnas bzod bde ba/ bang mdzod 'bru yis gang dus/ a ma gnas bzod bde ba/ gser nya 'khyug bgrod skyon dus/ chu mo gnas bzod bde ba/zhes brgyab ste tshang mar mchod chang gsum sgron mnyes dag re mchod dgos pa'i 'bod skul zhus na'ang zhang chen nas gtsos pa'i gral pa byings kyis da ni mchod chang gsum sgron mnyes dag zhus na nga tsho rta pa rnams rang tsho zin pa mi 'dug ces u tshugs mtha' skyel byas pas mthar gral pa byings la mchod chang gang mnyes re phul lo/ gral pa byings rnams mchod chang gang mnyes re mchod bsgrubs rjes a ma khrung ma rnams la lan 'debs kyi tshul du tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur ngang gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//gnas khang gangs stod mtho po/ mgron po seng ge dkar mo/ seng ge dkar mo'i blo gtad/ gangs stod phyogs la bcol yod/ gnas khang brag stod mtho po/ mgron po thang dkar rgod po/ thang dkar rgod po'i blo gtad/ brag stod phyogs la bcol yod/ gnas khang nyi 'od skyid pa/mgron po khams gsum dbang 'dus/ mgron po nga tsho'i blo gtad/ gnas khang 'di la bcol yod/ces snyan 'jibs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dbyangs rta la drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/lus la na bza' mchod yod/ lu gu tsha ru mchod yod/ dbu la dbu zhwa mchod yod/ tshe ring skying kheb mchod yod/ zhabs la zhabs phyags mchod yod/ zhabs phyags 'bur la 'ja' chen/ brlag song bor song med pa'i/ zhal bzhes gnang rogs gnang dang /114
zhes rdzul gyi krad kor dang gser gyi tshigs khobs sogs cog tsi nar mo'i zur du brdab bzhin zhabs bro bskyon pa'i ngang tshul byas byung ba na a ma khrung ma rnams nas gral pa byings la zhal skyems re phul te tshang ma bzhugs gral las grol te gzims 'jags gnang rgyu'i sta gon la zhugs so//de ltar nyin hril po'i mdzad sgo rnams bde blag ngang bsgrubs zin pa dang a ma khrung ma rnams nas yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral gyis gtsos pa'i rta pa rnams kyi gzims chas sgron rogs dang na bza' phud rogs kyi zhabs zhu'i bya ba rnams yongs su bsgrubs rjes gzim chung nyi 'od skyed nas thon te rang gnas su gzims 'jags gnang ba dang de yod gnyer pa sogs mi thams cad re zhig rmi lam 'phrul gyi rta po la chibs te stong pa'i zhing khams yangs por rgyu bzhin gnas so//smras pa/snang byed lta bu'i bu chung lha rgod dang //chu skyes bzhin gyi mdzes ma dbyangs can gnyis//mdza' gcugs zab pa mthun pa spun bzhi yi//mdzad pa'i rnam thar skyong la cis mi spro//zhes pa 'di ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//tho rengs chu tshod lnga pa yol tsam la nam tshod thig pa'i de pho tsha lu de yis ko ko ko zhes pa'i sgra dbyangs shig grags byung ba na ma byan tshe ring dpal mo dang yum chen padma dkar mo gnyis de mur mal las langs te me gtong chu len sogs kyi bya ba bgyis pa na gnyer pa sogs las rogs gzhan rnams kyang rim bzhin mal las langs te zhal khrus gtsang sbra sogs legs par bsgrubs rjes rang 'khri'i byed sgo khag sgrub bzhin pa dang a ma khrung ma rnams nas kyang mal las langs te ngo lag gtsang khrus sogs bsgrubs rjes 115
chab khol bsnams nas gzim chung nyi 'od skyid nang phebs te rta pa rnams la bkra shis bde legs kyi 'tshams 'dri dang bcas tshang mar chab khol drangs pa dang de rjes yab chen dang rta pa rnams kyang mal las bzhings te zhal khrus gtsang sbra gnang thog gzab mchor gyis brgyan te bkra shis khams bzang gi ngang nas bzhugs gral la 'khod do//yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral dang rta pa rnams gral du 'khod zin pa dang gnyer chen padma dar rgyas nas gsol nyir ngang pa ser ldan gyi nang du gsol ja drangs byung zhing gsol ja dang po zhal dkar dkar sangs nang zhus nas mchog gsum gyi sku mdun du phul ba dang de rjes yab chen nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gral pa byings la gsol ja zhus pa na yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral nas zhal dkar phyag tu bsnams te mchod skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / gang la gang 'dul bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ drin chen bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/zhes brjod pa na gral pa byings nas kyang yab chen dang mnyam du mchod pa phul rjes tshang mas gsol ja'i bro ba myong bzhin bzhugs so/ gral pa byings rnams gsol ja mchod kyin du bka' mol lhug por gsung ste gang 'tshams zhugs pa na gnyer pa padma dar rgyas dang gnyer g.yog kyen dga' dbang phyug gnyis kyis ma byan rnams kyi phyas rogs 'og chang skol dang zhal zas lnga sder sogs drangs te zhogs zas legs par phul ba dang rta pa dang khrung ma rnams zhogs zas mchod sgrub dus khri gdugs nyi ma de nyid kyang shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas 'dzum zhal rab tu ngoms byung ba na tshang ma thugs gseng gnang ste thog gsol la phebs rgyu'i gra sgrig zhu bzhin 'dug go/ thog khar gdan lcog sogs thog gsol la mkho ba'i dngos rdzas rnams gra sgrig 'thus tshang zhus 116
bsgrubs pa dang zhang chen tshangs pa rgyal po nas skas 'dzegs kyi mdun der 'gyings nyams ldan pa'i ngang phebs te am phrag las dkar gtsang kha btags shig yar la 'phyar te bkra shis rten 'brel gyi ched du sgrom skas de la bstod pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//o so sti bde legs su gyur cig bkra shis mi 'gyur lha yi khang bzang la/ bkra shis yar 'gro'i sgrom skas 'di ltar yod/ sgrom skas g.yas de tsan dan dkar pos grub/ tsan dan dkar po tshangs pa'i dngos grub yin/sgrom skas g.yon de tsan dan dmar pos grub/ tsan dan dmar po klu yi dngos grub yin/ skas ru 'ji dag g.yu byur phreng bas brgyan/ lha mo stong gis gnang ba'i dngos grub yin/ rin chen nor bus brgyan pa'i sgrom skas 'di/ bsod nams can la ma gtogs 'dzegs dbang med/ bsod nams can gyis sgrom skas 'dzegs zer na/ steng phyogs dag pa'i zhing du 'byor rgyu yin/ slob dpon padma'i mjal kha thob rgyu yin/ ki ki so so bkra shis so/zhes brjod bzhin mjal dar dkar gtsang nyi ma bde legs de sgrom skas la sgron nas mtho rgyal po chen po'i nyams ltar bgyis te sgrom skas 'dzegs nas thog gsol du phebs pa na yab chen rnam gnyis dang bu dang mna' ma/de bzhin rta pa gzhan rnams dang a ma khrung ma sogs rim pas thog khar phebs nas phyogs tshang la zhal phyogs te gral dang por yab chen nyi ma lha dkar dang gral gnyis par yab chen bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral/ gral gsum pa nas bu dang mna' ma/ zhang chen rnam gnyis bcas rim pas gral du 'khod cing zhang g.yog nor bu 'brug grags kyis a ma khrung ma rnams kyi rogs ram 'og dang thog lha bsang nam mkha' 'grib pa zhig btang ba dang de rjes pha yul tshong 'dus nas bsnams phebs pa'i gsol ja dang mchod chang / zhal tog 117
sogs kyis 'di bzhugs gral pa rnams la sne len zhus shing / zhang chen gnyis nas am phrag las phyag dpe ston te cog tsi nar mo'i steng du zhal phye ba dang khrus gsol gyi yo chas rnams mdun du bshams te bsang dang gser skyems/ khrus gsol sogs lha klu gzhi bdag mnyes pa'i cho ga rgya che zhig bsgrubs so//lha klu gzhi bdag mnyes pa'i cho ga rgya che zhig bsgrubs zin pa dang yab chen rnam gnyis nas gtsos pa'i gral bzhugs rnams gral nas bzhengs te khrung ma dang bcas pa tshang ma sgor sgor du bzhengs nas zhang chen tshangs pa rgyal po yi sne 'khrid 'og gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//ri mgo brgya nas zhus yod/ bsang sna lnga brgya zhus yod/ zhing bzang brgya nas zhus yod/ 'bru sna lnga brgya zhus yod/ chu mgo brgya nas zhus yod/ chu sna lnga brgya zhus yod/ces snyan 'jibs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dbyangs rta ring mo la drangs pa dang chabs cig zhabs bro/gnas khang 'di nas phul ba'i/ lha bsang sprin pa dkar po/ lha klu gzhi bdag mnyes te/ bu mo'i bsam don bsgrubs so/ bstan pa dar ba'i dar lcog btsugs so chog pa yod do//zhes brgyab rjes zhang chen tshangs pa rgyal po nas mjal dar dkar gtsang zhig am phrag las bton te phyag g.yon du bzung / sngon nas gra sgrig ang gsar zhus pa'i dar lcog dar mgo tshon sna lnga ldan can gyis brgyan pa de phyag g.yas su bzung nas dar de la bkra shis pa'i bshad pa 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//o so sti bde legs su gyur cig dgung a sngon nam mkha' yangs po la/ kun dga' ba'i nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms/ dma' sa gzhi padma'i pad 118
thang la/ bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel kun nas 'dzoms/ dge legs tshogs 'dzoms pa'i nyin mo la/ nged zhang chen phyag gi dar lcog 'di/ lha kun gyi spyi bo'i rgyan du btsugs/ dar 'di ko yar la ma btsugs gong / dar 'di yi grub tshul gleng zer na/ dar 'di la grub tshul rnam pa lnga/ dar shing de lha shing shug pa yin/ lha'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel yod/ dar gyi me long dri med dar dkar la/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i 'bru phreng mtshar du dngar/dar mtha' bzhi gos chen ser pos bskor/ chos bstan pas gling bzhi khyab pa'i rtags/ dar rtse ru yal ga lnga ldan yod/ 'di yal ga re rer sku re 'khrungs/ sku de dag mkha' 'gro sde lnga la/ khyim 'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yod/ dar dbu rtser byi'u dkar chung yod/ byi'u dkar chung dar rtser sgrog don ni/ khyim 'di yi rgyu nor longs spyod kun/ dus rtag tu rtse mor snyegs pa'i rtags/ dar 'di ko yar la btsugs zer na/ khyim 'di yi mi zog sems can kun/ rlung rta la nyi ma shar shar dang / lam 'gro la chu mo rgyugs rgyugs yin/ gi ki so so lha gsol lo//zhes brjod bzhin dar lcog de nyid lha tshugs kyi steng du btsugs pa dang slar yang snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i rnam thar 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//ta la'i la mo'i rtse nas/ bu ngas lha bsang btang yod/ bya de o rog nag chung / phye mar bzhes par phebs dang /de ltar zhang chen lags kyi mgrin pa gur gyi khang bzang las snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rnam thar zhig phul zin pa dang thog gsol gyi byed sgo rnams kyang legs par bsgrubs zin to/ thog gsol gyi byed sgo rnams bsgrubs pa dang tshang ma thog kha las babs te thugs gseng la phebs shing thugs gseng bsgrubs rjes gnyer chen padma dar rgyas nas rta pa rnams re zhig sku rtsed la gdan drangs shing la re sbag dang la re sho sogs rang rang 119
dga' ba'i sku rtsed la ci dgar rol bzhin bzhugs so//rta pa rnams zhogs pa'i chu tshod bcu gcig ma zin tsam nas nyin gung chu tshod gnyis pa ma zin tsam bar mchod chang mchod cing sku rtsed la ci dgar rol ba na gnyer chen padma dar rgyas nas da ni nyin gung gsol tshigs 'gyogs rgyu yin pas rta pa rnams sku rtsed mtshams bzhag ste bzhugs gral la 'khod par zhu zhes brjod pas yab chen dang rta pa rnams sngar bzhin bzhugs gral la 'khod do//rta pa rnams bzhugs gral la 'khod zin pa dang gnyer pa padma dar rgyas nas gral pa byings la gsol ras dang zhal tse phul ba dang gnyer g.yog kun dga' dbang phyug gis ma byan rnams kyi phyag rogs 'og bzhes 'bras dang bzhes tshal sna tshogs drangs te gzim chung nyi 'od skyid de nyid lha yi longs spyod mi yul du bshams pa ltar du gyur ro//rta pa dang khrung ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i gtang rag sngon du btang ste nyin gung gsol tshigs legs par bsgrubs pa dang a ma khrung ma rnams nas khrung phor dang ja khra bkyag ste gsol tshigs kyi rgyab snon tshul du gzhas chen 'di 'dra zhig phul lo//'khrungs sa steng phyogs lha la/ bzhugs sa rgyal po'i pho brang /dpon bzang gser sku 'dra la/ gzim chung gser gyi lha khang / dpon bzang yar la bzhengs dus/ nam mkha' 'od kyis khengs so/ dpon bzang mar la bzhugs dus/ sa gzhi 'od kyis khengs so/zhes snyan po'i ngag gi dril chung dkrol ba dang chabs cig zhabs bro/me tog dkar po gangs ri'i rtse la 'khrungs/ dpon po'i thugs sems gangs ri las kyang dkar/ me tog dmar po brag ri'i ldebs la 'khrungs/dpon po'i sku gzugs brag ri las kyang brtan/ me tog sngon po chu mo'i 120
